lines.en: : I think most of them are just on birth control.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她们大多都在吃避孕药。

lines.en: : Well, {i}I’m{/i} not! And I’m not about to get pregnant because-
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}可没有！而且我也不打算因为——就怀孕。

lines.en: : I can buy you something. Don’t worry. And...I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我可以给你买点药。别担心。还有……对不起。
: 对不起？……
: 看来是为了……{i}所有的事{/i}。
: 「所有的事」是什么意思？

lines.en: : For inviting you here without knowing Niki was coming back. For telling you I love you. For cumming inside of you without asking.
lines.zh: : 为了在不知道 Niki 会回来的情况下叫你来。为了跟你说我爱你。为了没问过你就射在你里面。

lines.en: : I’m clearly just doing everything wrong today, so I might as well apologize for all of it.
lines.zh: : 我今天显然什么都做错了，那不如干脆一起道歉。

lines.en: : It’s only the...last thing you need to apologize for. The other stuff is...
lines.zh: : 你需要道歉的只有……最后那件事。其他的都……
: 老师，你……并不{i}爱{/i}我。

lines.en: : But I’m flattered you...felt good enough to maybe {i}think{/i} you did for a second or...
lines.zh: : 不过我很荣幸你……舒服到也许有一瞬间{i}觉得{/i}自己爱上了我，或者说……

lines.en: : It wasn’t that. It was...something else. It was a lot of things. And lately, I-
lines.zh: : 不是那样。是……别的什么。是很多东西。而且最近，我——
门突然开了。

lines.en: And I imagine it’s the fastest either one of us has ever moved before.
lines.zh: 我猜这是我们俩这辈子动作最快的一次。
: 又有什么地方不对劲。

lines.en: : What do you mean? We’re exactly where you left us.
lines.zh: : 什么意思？我们就在你离开时的位置啊。

lines.en: : {i}Yes.{/i} But Sana’s face is very red and I’m almost positive the couch has moved several feet to the-
lines.zh: : {i}是{/i}。但 Sana 的脸很红，而且我几乎可以肯定沙发往——那边挪了好几英尺。

lines.en: : She’s been flustered ever since you got into the shower. We could hear you moving around all the way out here.
lines.zh: : 从你进去洗澡开始她就一直慌慌张张的。我们在这外面都能听见你们动来动去。

lines.en: : Really? I couldn’t hear anything in there. I guess that makes sense, though. I doubt there’s a lesbian teen in Kumon-mi who {i}wouldn’t{/i} look like that knowing I was naked just twenty feet away.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我在里面什么都没听见。不过想想也说得通。我敢说 Kumon-mi 就没有哪个同性恋少女，知道我就在二十英尺外光着身子，还能{i}不{/i}露出那种表情的。

lines.en: : I’m glad knowing I can just convince you of anything so long as I play into how great you think you are.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴知道，只要顺着你自以为有多了不起的那点心思，我说什么你都信。

lines.en: : Hm? Did you say something, babe? I was just thinking about how great I am.
lines.zh: : 嗯？你说了什么吗，亲爱的？我刚才正在想我自己有多伟大呢。

lines.en: : Nope. And, in fact, we were just wrapping up here. Right, Sana?
lines.zh: : 没有。而且事实上，我们这儿已经要收尾了。对吧，Sana？
: Sana？
: 啊！对、对不起……什么？……

lines.en: : I...I think I...zoned out for...a second...
lines.zh: : 我……我想我……走神了……一下……
: {i}我们刚才正要收尾了{/i}。对吧？
: 我们……是吗？

lines.en: : Oh! I mean...y...yeah! Of course we were...I...know a lot more about the...Lord of the Size now-
lines.zh: : 啊！我的意思是……是、是啊！我们当然是在收尾……我现在……对《Size 王》了解多了——

lines.en: : FLIES! Lord of the...Flies. That...is the...
lines.zh: : 蝇！是《蝇……蝇王》。那……就是……
: 那是……呃……的名字……

lines.en: : I have to go! Work! Bye!
lines.zh: : 我得走了！要上班！再见！
: 《Size 王》，是吧？

lines.en: : She meant flies. She said it herself.
lines.zh: : 她想说的是蝇。她自己说的。

lines.en: : Akira...you know you can talk to me if there’s something you-
lines.zh: : Akira……你知道如果有什么事，你都可以跟我说的——
: 我没事，Niki。
: 浴缸里的水还满着吗？

lines.en: : Hm? Oh. No, I emptied it. You normally wait until later to-
lines.zh: : 嗯？哦。不，我放掉了。你平时都会等到晚些才——

lines.en: : I think I’m going to call it early tonight. I’ll probably be asleep by the time you get back from dance class.
lines.zh: : 我想今晚早点睡了。等你上完舞蹈课回来，我大概已经睡着了。

lines.en: : You sure you don’t want to talk?
lines.zh: : 你确定不想聊聊吗？
: 我确定。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}You and Ami are going to be the death of me, I swear.
lines.zh: : {i}哈{/i}……你和 Ami 迟早会把我折磨死，我发誓。

lines.en: : Probably not the best thing to say given our background.
lines.zh: : 考虑到我们的过往，这话大概不太合适。
: 那是因为——哦。{i}哦，该死{/i}。宝贝，我——

lines.en: : It’s fine. Be more careful around Ami, though. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 没事。不过在 Ami 身边多小心点。谢了。
: Akira——
: 晚安，Niki。

lines.en: : I’ll see you in the morning.
lines.zh: : 明天早上见。

lines.en: I can’t help but sigh as I make my way into the room and stand before the bed, unsure of whether I want to collapse into it or try and suffocate myself with the pillow.
lines.zh: 我走进房间，站在床前，忍不住叹了口气，拿不准自己是要倒进床里，还是想用枕头把自己闷死。

lines.en: I think about sending Sana a text but ultimately decide against it. I’d rather she just forget everything.
lines.zh: 我想过给 Sana 发条短信，但最终决定不发。我宁愿她把这一切都忘掉。

lines.en: I think I’d rather forget too.
lines.zh: 我想我也宁愿忘掉。
我选择了倒下去，而不是窒息。

lines.en: Someone already took my breath away.
lines.zh: 已经有人把我的呼吸夺走了。
{i}Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]!{/i}
{i}Sana 的欲望提升到了 [sana_lust]!{/i}
{i}你们注定不能在一起！{/i}
{i}她只是在做她的工作。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But on the bright side, you can invite her over whenever you want now!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过往好的方面想，现在你想什么时候叫她过来都行了！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Hope you’re ready for her to ride your dick off!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}希望你做好准备，她会把你的鸡巴骑断的！{/i}
